reason: The soybean row is ready to sow, so the seeds can go straight into the growing beds.
expectation: The soybean seeds will be planted in their prepared row.

effect: The soybean row is planted; the potatoes and lettuce still need their respective preparations.
reaction: The direct sowing worked as expected.
reason: Packing foil can make the lightproof skirt needed around the potato bay.
expectation: The foil will form a lightproof skirt for the potato bay.

effect: The foil needed a cloth backing first; the resulting sheet is lightproof and flexible.
reaction: The compatibility feedback made the missing preparation clear.
reason: The foil-backed cloth looks suited to the potato bay's lightproof skirt.
expectation: The sheet will form a skirt around the potato bay.

effect: The potato bay now has the lightproof skirt needed for planting.
reaction: The skirt's distinction between shaded tubers and lit shoots is useful.
reason: The prepared potato bay is ready for the seed potatoes.
expectation: The seed potatoes will be planted in the shaded bay.

effect: The potatoes are planted, leaving the lettuce goal and its dry shelf.
reason: The lettuce shelf needs an absorbent wick; clean cover fabric is the most plausible material.
expectation: The fabric will provide a wick from the inlet to the lettuce shelf.

effect: The lettuce shelf now has a wick to draw solution up to its root mat, so it is ready for planting.
reaction: The passive wick is a useful, straightforward solution.
reason: The prepared lettuce bed can now receive the lettuce seeds.
expectation: The lettuce seeds will be planted in the watered bed.

effect: The lettuce is sown, completing the final planting goal and the chapter.
reaction: The final planting worked as expected.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the lettuce wick was most worthwhile: it showed how absorbent fabric can draw solution up to roots without another pump.

leastWorthwhile.text: The direct sowing actions were predictable and offered little decision-making, though they made the planting progress clear.

surprise.text: The foil could not be fitted directly to the beds; it first needed cloth backing to make a flexible, tear-resistant lightproof sheet.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt wholly arbitrary. The need for cloth backing was not obvious before trying the foil, but the result explained its practical purpose.

continue.text: I would continue: the practical details of shading potato tubers and passively watering lettuce made me curious to see how the crops develop.
